## Approach

Two independent, text-only edits. Neither changes runtime behaviour.

1. **The stale TODO.** In `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts`, the doc comment directly above
   `getProfileData` (read this run, lines 52–58) ends with the line
   `* TODO: Add organizationId parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md).` Replace that one
   line, and only that line, with one sentence stating the rule. Suggested wording:
   `* The profile is per person, not per workspace, so getProfileData takes no organization id.`
   The rest of the comment (it reads the `user` and `user_profiles` rows in parallel, the personal section only, and
   the defaults filled from the `user` row) stays word for word. Keep the blank ` *` line between the description and
   the new sentence. The function signature `getProfileData(userId: string): Promise<ProfileData>`, its body and its
   E2E fixture branch are not touched.

2. **The unformatted doc.** `npx prettier --check docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` exits 1 today (confirmed this
   run). A read-only preview (`npx prettier <file> | diff <file> -`) shows the whole fix is **one inserted blank
   line** after line 63: between the end of list item 1's last paragraph ("…still makes the answer invalid
   (`POLICY_UNAVAILABLE`).") and the line `2. The check runs locally, exactly as today, with precedence`. The build
   runs `npx prettier --write docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` (that one file, named, never a directory or glob),
   or makes the same one-line insertion with Edit. No wording changes. The project's `.prettierrc.json` (the
   `prettier-plugin-tailwindcss` plugin) and the installed Prettier `^3.10.1` decide the result.

## Applied lessons

- none — the project has no memory-bank canon yet (`check-lessons-index.mjs --verdict` returned `NO_CANON` this run),
  so there are no lessons to apply.

## Steps

- Edit `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts`: replace the TODO line in the `getProfileData` doc comment with
  the per-person sentence. Change nothing else in the file.
- Format `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` with the project's Prettier (the single named file). Confirm with
  `git diff` that the only change is the blank line before item `2.` and no word moved.
- Run `npx prettier --check docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` (exit 0),
  then the gates the SPEC names: `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test`, `npm run format:check`.
- Run the existing `features/profile/services/__tests__/get-profile.test.ts` unchanged; it must stay green (no
  behaviour change).

## Files

- `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` — the `getProfileData` doc comment's TODO line replaced by one sentence: the profile is per person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id
- `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` — Prettier formatting only (one blank line inserted before list item `2.`); no wording change

### Explicitly not touched

- `features/profile/services/__tests__/get-profile.test.ts` — the existing profile tests stay as they are (SPEC non-goal)
- `features/profile/` (every other file) — no other TODO or formatting cleanup (SPEC non-goal)
- `CLAUDE.md` — no convention changes; the TODO pointed at it, but it says nothing about such a parameter and needs no edit
- `.prettierrc.json`, `.prettierignore`, `package.json` — the formatter's configuration and scripts stay as they are

## Acceptance mapping

- AC-1 (no "multi-workspace support", no TODO line naming `organizationId`, under `features/profile/`) → the
  replaced line was the only match (grep this run: `get-profile.ts:57`); after the edit neither search matches. The AC
  test in `AC-TESTS.md` walks `features/profile/` and reads every file as text.
- AC-2 (the doc comment above `getProfileData` says the profile is per person, not per workspace, and that it takes
  no organization id) → the new sentence in that comment.
- AC-3 (`npx prettier --check docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` exits 0) → the formatted file.

## Risks & open questions

- **The AC-1 test lives under the tree it searches.** Its file sits in `features/profile/__tests__/`, so it must not
  itself hold the phrase "multi-workspace support", nor a single line holding both `TODO` and `organizationId`, or AC-1
  fails on the test's own text. `/pharn-test` should build the needles from parts (e.g. `["multi-workspace",
  "support"].join(" ")`) and skip its own file when walking. This is noted in the AC-1 target in `AC-TESTS.md`.
- **The AC-2 wording check.** The sentence's exact words are the build's choice; the AC test should match the rule
  case-insensitively (the comment says "per person", "not per workspace" and "no organization id"), not one fixed
  string. The suggested wording above contains all three.
- **The AC-3 test spawns a process.** `npx prettier --check` resolves the local devDependency (no network) but takes a
  few seconds with the Tailwind plugin; the test needs a per-test timeout above the 10 s default (e.g. 30 s).
- **Formatting the test files themselves.** `npm run format:check` covers the new AC test files; `/pharn-test` should
  write them already formatted, or `format:check` goes red for a reason outside this plan's files.
- `main` must still be failing `format:check` only on `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` when the build runs. If
  another file has gone unformatted since, it is out of scope (SPEC non-goal) and the `format:check` gate would stay
  red. Flag it; do not format it.

---
spec_id: profile-todo-cleanup
state: Approved
spec_content_hash: 928dc06f5d3a89154a21e41cc06678e4633a9d6ea607340260f4c1f670892059
approved_by: model
spec_template: pharn-default@sha256:0ac964d307ef33dc333d1eae764877b6ea5ae4006fe3fcad4dc54ed58a0478a4
---

## Intent

The doc comment on `getProfileData` in `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` still says "TODO: Add organizationId
parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md)". That TODO is stale. Workspaces have existed for
months, the profile page is personal-only by decision (`pharn/features/profile-personal-only`), `getProfileData` reads
only one person's `user` and `user_profiles` rows, and CLAUDE.md says nothing about such a parameter. A future reader
could take the TODO as a pending piece of work and add a workspace parameter to a per-person read. The owner wants the
TODO replaced with one doc-comment sentence that states the actual rule: the profile is per person, not per workspace,
so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.

Separately, `main` currently fails `npm run format:check` on one file, `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md`, which
was merged unformatted in #384. The owner wants Prettier run on that one file so the gate is green again, with only
its formatting changed and none of its wording.

## Scope

**In scope:**

- Replace the stale TODO line in the `getProfileData` doc comment with one sentence stating that the profile is per
  person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.
- Reformat `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` with the project's Prettier configuration so that
  `npx prettier --check` passes on it.

**Out of scope (non-goals):**

- Any change to the behaviour of `getProfileData`: its signature, its return value and its E2E fixture branch.
- Any change to the existing profile tests.
- Any change to the wording, structure or meaning of `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md`. Only Prettier's
  whitespace and markup normalisation is allowed.
- Reformatting, or cleaning up TODOs in, any other file.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-1** Given the files under `features/profile/` When their text is searched for "multi-workspace support" and
  for a TODO that mentions an `organizationId` parameter Then neither search returns a match
  - verify: unit

findings.problem: The SPEC constraint that docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md changes formatting only, never wording, is verified only by a manual look at git diff; no AC test or deterministic command checks it, so a wording change slipped in alongside the blank line would pass AC-3 and every gate.
findings.evidence: Confirm with `git diff` that the only change is the blank line before item `2.` and no word moved.

findings.problem: The plan states the AC-3 test's `npx prettier --check` makes no network call, but bare npx falls back to downloading a package when the local bin is missing; nothing makes that true unless the test uses `npx --no-install` or the local node_modules/.bin/prettier, and the test also adds a multi-second subprocess to every later `npm run test` that duplicates `format:check`.
findings.evidence: `npx prettier --check` resolves the local devDependency (no network) but takes a few seconds with the Tailwind plugin; the test needs a per-test timeout above the 10 s default (e.g. 30 s).

findings.problem: The plan changes a TS source file that no test added by the PR imports (the AC tests read get-profile.ts as text), so the repository's pharn-ci step will likely warn TESTS_NOT_EXERCISING_CHANGES on this PR; the plan does not anticipate it, and the build must not clear it by importing get-profile.ts into the text-reading AC test.
findings.evidence: `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` — the `getProfileData` doc comment's TODO line replaced by one sentence

dispositions.reason: Minor: the plan's step already has the build compare git diff and the change is a single blank line in a file the plan names; a whitespace-only diff check (git diff -w --ignore-blank-lines) is a cheap extra the build can run, not a plan change.

Minor: the plan already names the per-test timeout, and prettier is a local devDependency so npx resolves it offline; the AC-3 test is the SPEC's own verify: integration choice, and the test stage may call the local bin or npx --no-install without any plan edit.

Accepted bound: a TESTS_NOT_EXERCISING_CHANGES warning on a comment-only change never fails a check, the existing get-profile.test.ts covers the function, and the build must not import get-profile.ts into the text-reading test just to clear it.
